errors.text_span: die Balken für "gleichbleibend" und "steigend" haben eine Höhe von etwa 40 %
errors.evidence: Description states 40%, but the graph shows values for 'gleichbleibend' around 38-44% and 'steigend' around 25%.
The description does not mention that the chart shows both business volume expectations and employment expectations.
The description fails to identify that the bars are grouped and not presented as a single series.
The description does not mention the categories on the vertical axis.
It omits the fact that the ticks on the x-axis are at 5% intervals.
